g.text: Cross-Traffic RSU Controller — UPPAAL → C → FreeRTOS + VHDL
V0 emergency, V1 east-straight, V2 west-straight
V3 straight, V4 north-right, V5 south-left
V4 and V5 must NEVER cross together
E<> V1 && V2 cross together in M/M/2
New: V5 bounded waiting with aging
Software keeps the flexible control logic:
messages, priority, aging, timers, queue state.
Hardware keeps the repeated parallel safety logic:
conflict matrix, capacity check, collision alarm.
